candidates.title: staging-pre-resync-2026-05-24: dev to staging (#2863)
candidates.summary: updates working-ios perf(home): cache remote app icons to file:// + lazy-mount AllAppsGrid Idle on the home screen on Android was holding the GPU pipeline at ~15fps and burning ~38% of one CPU core, causing the phone to get warm. Profiling on a Pixel 6a (dev build) traced this to components on the home screen with https:// sources — both expo-image and RN Image keep the View hierarchy invalidating continuously when fed remote URIs. The threshold showed up between 8 and 11 mounted remote-icon Image instances; below that, idle CPU was at the app baseline (~18%). Two contributors: AppIcon used expo-image with remote URLs for store-installed apps. AllAppsGridSheet kept its mounted while the bottom sheet was closed, so 80+ remote-icon Images were rendering off-screen. Fix: New useCachedRemoteImageSource hook: for https:// sources, asks expo-image for the disk-cache path (prefetching if needed), returns {uri: "file://..."}. Local require()'d sources pass through unchanged. Module-scoped cach
